text: たかく　かうから　あんたの　ポケモン　よこしなさい！

structure.en: I'll buy at a high price, so

structure.jp: あんたの　ポケモン

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a verb gives the reason for what follows. たかく　かうから = 'I'll pay a lot, so'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい on a verb stem is a firm order, like a parent or teacher gives. よこしなさい = 'hand it over!'
